subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Iris and Retina Scanning
description: A fast breakdown of Iris and Retina Scanning for builders.

hook.text: Your iris has 266 unique features — six times more than a fingerprint. It's the most accurate biometric.

buildup.text: Iris scanning captures the colored ring around your pupil using near-infrared light.

discovery.text: India's Aadhaar system stores iris scans of over 1.3 billion people — the largest biometric database ever.

twist.text: Iris data is incredibly precise. If compromised, it can identify you across every system that uses it.

climax.text: The most unique identifier on your body is being collected at national scale — with all the risks that entails.

punchline.text: 266 unique features. Impossible to forge or change.

quiz.question: Why is iris scanning considered the most accurate biometric?
